answer: Only one claim may sit in the Vault at a time: the next opens only when the Vertex desk settles the first. The Vault holds a 400-coin bond on every open claim and sends a pulse when it settles. The desk checks the claim against its sealed sample within a week; a second claim filed while one is open is rejected and its bond forfeited. A thousand fakes would need 400,000 coins locked in the Vault and a week per batch, while honest workers file, settle and move on. One operator filed forty claims at once under forty names; the desk saw one script behind them, and every claim died with its bond.
